QUOTE: Conjunction is diagnosed. `token_hits` shows per-token counts, and the note says which token emptied the match. Here both tokens were zero, so the note tells the caller to retry with fewer tokens, not to conclude absence.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes current diagnostics for multi-token conjunction, but never says a single token matching nothing was previously treated as proof of absence, nor frames that as a past conflation of "nothing exists" with "did not look".
